full_text: Hello team, welcome to the sprint kickoff meeting. Today we agreed to migrate our database to PostgreSQL 16. David: I will complete the database schema migration and prepare the rollback scripts by next Wednesday. Sarah: I can handle updating the authentication API documentation once the PR is submitted. Alex: We also need someone to benchmark query latency on the staging cluster before month end, but we haven't assigned an owner yet. Facilitator: Exactly. Also, what is our fallback strategy if the cloud migration window exceeds four hours? Let's leave that as an open question. Let us meet again on Friday for the sprint retrospective.
